title: Growth in transhipment for Middle East prompts niche Red Sea services
content:
Middle East-bound cargo transhipping via India is prompting secondary and niche container lines to expand their Red Sea service offerings, despite the escalating risks in the conflict region.
Italy’s Messina Line — predominantly a ro-ro operator — has introduced a, standalone “opportunistic” India-Red Sea loop.
The Red Sea Express will link JNPA (Nhava Sheva) in India with Sohar (Oman) and Jeddah (Saudi Arabia), now key gateways for imports into the Persian Gulf.

title: Drone carrying explosives found at Leipzig Airport
content:
A counterterrorism investigation was opened by the German authorities yesterday after a drone carrying explosives was found near a runway at Leipzig/Halle Airport overnight.

Areas of the site, which is the location of a major DHL hub, were shut down.
